name: web-fatis-donut-site-screens-grid-in-pink
title: Fati's donut site: animated overview grid of pink screens (hero, how it works, bundles, categories)
whatItIs: An animated grid of rounded browser frames showing Fati's pages: the 'Sweet Moments for Every Craving' hero, a 'How it works' three-step section, 'Build Your Bundle', categories, product grids and a brand story with a pink donut illustration.
whatItMeans: Complete and lively; tiling every screen proves the brand feel holds site-wide.
techniques: Tile all key screens in a neat grid.
Keep hot pink as the constant across pages.
Use handwritten yellow sub-headings under bold titles.

vocabulary.definition: A tiled overview of many pages.
A handwritten line under a bold title.
